reasoning: On the season so far the 76ers are the stronger team; with home court the 76ers start about 5 points better, in a game of about 224 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Pacers.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Pacers (revenge).
Bottom line: the 76ers win 69 times in 100, by about 4; most games like this end between 200 and 248 total points.

analyst.text: Philadelphia's frontcourt is in a bind: Joel Embiid sits for plantar fascia management and, with Adem Bona and Dominick Barlow also out, two-way player Tacko Fall is the only healthy center, so LeBron James may log minutes at the five. Indiana arrive with a lift after beating the defending-champion Knicks in the NBA Cup, a win Rick Carlisle praised for its underdog fight, even though Tyrese Haliburton's comeback is stalled by a hamstring strain. The news angle leans slightly towards the Pacers keeping it closer than the records suggest.
